entities.summary: Georges Alphonse Fleury Izambard was a French lycée professor of rhetoric and alumnus of prestigious École normale supérieure, best known as the teacher and benefactor of poet Arthur Rimbaud. He was a renowned journalist and close friend of Renoir after he left teaching. He taught at the Collège de Charleville in Charleville, where his nickname was "Zanzibar".
